say:2:1530124602:1.text: A sudden flood like that—it must have been divine punishment from the Hunting Goddess!
say:2:1530124602:1.source_cn: 这么突然的洪水，一定是狩猎神你降下的神罚！
say:2:1530124602:1.male: A sudden flood like that—it must have been divine punishment from the Hunting Goddess!
say:2:1530124602:1.female: A sudden flood like that—it must have been divine punishment from the Hunting Goddess!

say:3:1530124603:1.text: Thanks to your protection, those apes will finally quiet down for a while!
say:3:1530124603:1.source_cn: 仰赖你的庇护，那些猿人总算能消停一阵了！
say:3:1530124603:1.male: Thanks to your protection, those apes will finally quiet down for a while!
say:3:1530124603:1.female: Thanks to your protection, those apes will finally quiet down for a while!
